data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Ammuna refers to the mother of the believers, a term used to describe the wives of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and other prominent Muslim women. The name evokes images of compassionate care, unwavering faith, and a strong sense of community. The name Ammuna carries the meaning “Mother of the Believers” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ammuna usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of the believers and live with faith, good character and purpose.
